description: This file defines the Patient data model class with serialization and copying capabilities, used to represent patient information within the healthcare Flutter frontend project.

classes.name: Patient
classes.description: A data model class representing a patient with fields for personal information, JSON serialization/deserialization, and immutable copying.

methods.name: Patient.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor to create a Patient instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the Patient instance into a JSON map.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Returns a copy of the Patient instance with optional modifications to fields.
